instruction: Middleware configurations are turned into middleware without knowing which Echo instance they will serve. Add a required parameter `e *Echo` to the `ToMiddleware` method of the `echo.MiddlewareConfigurator` interface (echo.go), so it becomes `ToMiddleware(e *Echo) (MiddlewareFunc, error)`, and change every configuration type that implements it (every `XxxConfig.ToMiddleware` in the middleware package, as `ToMiddleware(e *echo.Echo) (echo.MiddlewareFunc, error)`) and every call of `ToMiddleware`, in source and in tests. At each call pass the `*echo.Echo` the middleware is being built for when the calling function has one in scope (in tests this is usually the `e := echo.New()` instance); where there is none (e.g. `toMiddlewareOrPanic`, used by the `XxxWithConfig` constructors, and tests that build middleware without an Echo instance) pass `nil`. Implementations do not have to use the parameter yet and must accept `nil`. Do not keep a parameterless variant. Behavior must not change.
gold_tool: build_deep.py go recipe: declarations by pattern (func (config XxxConfig) ToMiddleware() and the interface line), call sites from go build/go test compile errors (-gcflags=-e), iterated to a clean build; gofmt (go1.25.14 GOTOOLCHAIN=local)
change: add required parameter (interface method: 22 middleware config implementations + callers)
notes: Call-site value: the enclosing function's `e := echo.New()` when present, else nil.
